title: East Jerusalem Palestinians Mount Legal Battles Against Displacement
detail: Palestinians in East Jerusalem are pursuing legal challenges to remain in their homes amid sustained Israeli displacement pressures and continued settlement expansion. Families face eviction proceedings and administrative hurdles as Israeli authorities advance plans in contested neighborhoods.

title: Israeli Forces Conduct Sweeping West Bank Raids; 13 Palestinians Detained
detail: Israeli forces carried out wide-ranging raids across the West Bank, torching a prayer room and attacking farmers. At least 13 Palestinians were detained including arrests in the Jenin and Nablus areas. Raids encompassed multiple villages and involved both military and settler-related incidents.
